data.title: Planning storage for an Indian apartment
data.excerpt: A sample guide to balancing generous storage with visual calm in compact and mid-sized homes.
data.body: Sample editorial content — replace with a verified studio article before publishing as business advice. Begin by mapping daily routines rather than filling every available wall. Separate frequently used items from seasonal storage, protect clear circulation, and use full-height joinery only where it does not make the room feel narrow. In kitchens and utilities, plan around actual appliances, cooking habits and waste management. In bedrooms, combine accessible everyday storage with higher cabinets for luggage and seasonal textiles.

data.title: Choosing a warm material palette for Hyderabad homes
data.excerpt: Sample notes on combining timber, stone, texture and warm light without making a space feel visually heavy.
data.body: Sample editorial content — replace with a verified studio article before publishing as business advice. Start with one dominant natural tone, then layer variation through grain, weave and subtle texture. Use stone where durability and cooling matter, timber where touch and warmth matter, and textured finishes where changing daylight can bring the surface to life. Warm lighting should reveal material character rather than flatten it.
